Replies of the Nexus Mods API v1, one file per request path (`/` → `_`, query dropped).
**Written by hand** from the API's published schema (https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis-docs/NexusMods/nexus-mods_public_api_params_in_form_data/1.0)
and the fields MO2's `NexusInterface` reads; no live call was made. The user, key and e-mail are
placeholders.
